subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should OpenClaw make owner-qualified `skills install --force` fail when the existing tracked skill has the same slug but a different owner?
rationale: The patch prevents silent installed-skill replacement and aligns install with update/verify owner checks, but it changes existing force-install behavior for workflows that intentionally used cross-owner replacement.

options.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
options.body: Merge this as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

options.title: Require explicit override path
options.body: Ask for a deliberate owner-change override if maintainers want cross-owner replacement to remain possible without silent clobbering.

options.title: Preserve current force behavior
options.body: Reject the guard and keep `--force` as an unconditional same-slug replacement across owners, accepting the clobber risk.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed owner guard
recommendation.body: Merge this as the preferred data-integrity fix and accept the compatibility break for cross-owner forced replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: CONTRIBUTING.md lists this handle as the ClawHub and data-integrity area owner, and the remaining choice is policy/compatibility rather than a code repair.
